maddeler.e:
أرتجف (form VIII)
# أَرْتَجِفُ (ʔartajifu) /ʔar.ta.d͡ʒi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَجَفَ (irtajafa)
# أَرْتَجِفَ (ʔartajifa) /ʔar.ta.d͡ʒi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَجَفَ (irtajafa)
# أَرْتَجِفْ (ʔartajif) /ʔar.ta.d͡ʒif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَجَفَ (irtajafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
